svg.text: The hub: #164 — the badge closest to ALL the others (min total shape distance 845)
total shape distance = Σ over all 194 badges of the symmetric difference of active-prime sets · the four all-15-prime badges #116/#149/#164/#187 tie at 845; ℓ¹ picks #164 uniquely
green ring = the hub · dark spokes to its 8 nearest badges by shape (#116/#187/#149 sit at distance 0 — they also draw all 15 primes)
amber satellites = the guessed hubs: #161 is a genuine near-hub (13/15 primes, rank 37, d=2); #160 is peripheral (8/15 primes, rank 173, d=7)
